definitions.explanation: Having a short lifespan. Used for people, animals, products, organizations, or anything that does not last long.

examples.japanese: {短命|たんめい}な{政権|せいけん}だった。
この{虫|むし}は{短命|たんめい}で、{一週間|いっしゅうかん}しか{生|い}きられない。
examples.english: This insect is short-lived and can only live for one week.

examples.japanese: {短命|たんめい}に{終|お}わった{新商品|しんしょうひん}も{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: There are quite a few new products that were short-lived.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {短命|たんめい}に{終|お}わる: to be short-lived, to end quickly
- {短命|たんめい}な{政権|せいけん}: short-lived administration
- {短命|たんめい}{内閣|ないかく}: short-lived cabinet

OPPOSITE:
- {長命|ちょうめい}: long life
- {長寿|ちょうじゅ}: longevity
